services.value: Envirotech provides environmental consulting and remediation services including emergency spill response, hazardous material abatement & remediation, and laboratory sample analysis for soil and waste water. It also offers services such as UST/AST closure assessments, environmental site assessments (Phase I, II, and III), air quality management (including emission inventory plans and emissions testing), LUST remediation management, site remediation and contamination management, demolition/construction, and landfarm remediation of hydrocarbon-contaminated soil and water.
